title: Wish list
notes: New Wish list in Savings: add something to buy or a trip, with a price and an optional date
The app works out your free money each month from your bills and spending, how much to save each month, and how long it will take
If the date is too tight it shows where you can trim (streaming, eating out, shopping) and the earliest date that works
Set money aside moves money from a pot into the wish. Bought marks it done
